gloss: principal (of a kindergarten or preschool); director

definitions.gloss: principal of a kindergarten or nursery; director
definitions.explanation: The head of a 幼稚園 (kindergarten) or 保育園 (nursery). Also used for the director of facilities ending in 園, such as a botanical garden or zoo.

examples.japanese: {園長|えんちょう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あいさつする。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{園長|えんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{入園式|にゅうえんしき}→入園式：20145_nyuuenshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{園長|えんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あいさつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the entrance ceremony, the principal greeted the parents.

notes:
Compound of {園|えん} (garden; facility ending in 園) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). In everyday school contexts it means the head of a kindergarten or nursery, usually addressed as {園長|えんちょう}⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧.
